## Install

```jsonc
// opencode.json and tui.json
{ "plugin": ["opencode-usage-stats-plugin"] }
Or npm i opencode-usage-stats-plugin. Requires OpenCode >= 1.18.30.
What's new
- Published to npm: one-line install, no clone/build needed
- User-level config at ~/.config/opencode/usage-stats-plugin.json (survives updates)
- Stable default database dir so updates never wipe history
更新内容
- 发布到 npm，一行配置即可安装，无需 clone/build
- 用户级配置文件，插件更新不丢失
- 默认数据库目录稳定，更新不再丢历史
